title: Unvented roof deck
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A renovation to a single-family dwelling included a covered roof deck over new living space. Permit drawings showed ventilation above mineral-fibre insulation, but medium-density spray foam conforming to CAN/ULC-S705.1 was installed without venting.
The appellant cited air-tight spray foam and a monolithic assembly; the building official raised moisture accumulation and possible future roof-deck structural damage if the roofing membrane failed.
The disputed provision is Sentence 9.19.1.1.(1), which requires roof-space ventilation unless shown unnecessary.
